full_prompt_en: A square-format color landscape photograph presents a vast snowbound mountain range from a high, exposed viewpoint beside a dark rock overhang. The nearest rock occupies the upper right edge as a steep brown-black wall, irregular and coarse, with a lip that cuts into the pale sky. Below it, pale rough snow clings to a descending slope in the lower right foreground. Across the center rises a steep pyramidal peak with jagged shoulders and closely scored ridges of ice and dark stone. Its summit is slightly left of center, and lower serrated peaks continue across the horizon toward both sides. Farther left, overlapping blue mountains fade in layers; below them, the broad glacial valley is filled with wrinkled white and slate-blue snow, channels, and crevasse-like lines. On the right, darker ridges descend toward the same valley and help frame the distant central summit. The sun appears low near the horizon just to the right of the main peak, partially screened by the nearer rock. Its small golden burst sends a narrow warm flare into the cold scene and turns the horizon pale ivory. The sky grades from clear powder blue above the mountain to a brighter, warmer band near the sun. The photograph has crisp natural detail in the near rock and ice, with distant contours softened slightly by thin atmosphere. Blue shadow covers most of the valley, while brief warm light catches the upper ridge and the edge of the overhang. The viewpoint conveys enormous distance without losing the tactile grain of the foreground surface. The composition sets the dark close vertical rock against a wide open procession of snowy peaks, holding a quiet instant just as dawn reaches the high landscape.
full_prompt_zh: 一张方形构图的彩色风景照片从高处裸露的视点、深暗岩檐旁展现广阔覆雪群山。最近的岩石占据右上边缘，形成粗糙不规则的棕黑陡壁，突出的檐口切入浅色天空。檐下浅色粗雪附在右下前景的下降坡面。画面中央一座陡峭金字塔形山峰升起，肩线锯齿般起伏，冰与深石在斜脊上刻出紧密纹路。峰顶位于中心略偏左，较低的锯齿群峰向两侧延续在地平线上。更远的左侧，重叠蓝山层层褪淡；其下宽阔冰川谷地充满起皱的白色与石板蓝雪面、沟道和裂隙般的线条。右侧更暗山脊下降至同一谷地，帮助框住远处中央峰顶。太阳低悬在主峰略偏右的地平线附近，部分被近处岩石挡住。小小金色光芒向冷色场景送出一道窄暖光，并把地平线染成浅象牙色。天空从山上方的清淡粉蓝渐变为太阳附近较亮较暖的一带。照片中近处岩石与冰雪有清晰自然细节，远处轮廓则被薄薄空气略微软化。蓝影覆盖谷地大部，短暂暖光只落在较高山脊和岩檐边缘。视点传达巨大的距离，却没有丢失前景表面的可触颗粒。构图以近处深暗的竖向岩壁对着宽阔展开的雪峰队列，留住黎明刚触到高山的一瞬安静。
style_prompt_en: Color photography holds crisp tactile texture in the foreground and lets successive cool layers recede through thin atmospheric haze. A large near-dark shape cuts against expansive pale space, giving scale to distant angular lines and finely striated surfaces. Blue, steel gray, and cold white cover most of the image; a very small band of gold and ivory marks low directional light. Shadow areas retain subtle surface detail rather than collapsing into black, while bright edges remain clean and restrained. The composition uses a close vertical boundary to frame a far-reaching horizontal field, creating a strong contrast between immediate tactile mass and immense open depth. Clear natural light and slight atmospheric softening keep the scene precise yet spacious.
style_prompt_zh: 彩色摄影让前景可触的质地清晰，后续冷色层次则穿过薄薄空气雾向远方递退。大片近处深色形态切入宽阔浅色空间，为远处棱角线与细密条纹表面建立尺度。蓝、钢灰与冷白覆盖画面大部，极小的一道金色与象牙色标记低角度定向光。阴影区保留细微表面细节而不坍成纯黑，亮边清楚却克制。构图用贴近的竖向界线框住伸向远方的横向广阔区域，让眼前可触大块与极大的开放纵深形成鲜明对照。清透自然光与轻微大气柔化使画面准确而有空间。
theme_en: A snowbound mountain range seen from beside a dark rock overhang at sunrise
theme_zh: 日出时从深暗岩檐旁望向覆雪群山
name: Jimmy Chin
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
